_comment: Verified public problem lists, seeded by scripts/seed-problem-sets.js. Every set cites its public source; we list the problems we have (matched by LeetCode id) and link the original. No paid, private or leaked lists. Company PYQ comes from staff-added public sources and community "asked at" reports, never invented. NeetCode 150, Blind 75 and the other well-known lists are built in (content/problem-sets/library.json), so they are not seeded here.

series.title: Grind 75
